reading.body:
No operator-published specifications for this facility are available. The Bloomberg data center's capacity, power draw, cooling, and electrical infrastructure are not documented in accessible sources, making it impossible to assess its scale or role in AI infrastructure.

Bloomberg operates this site in Orangeburg, New York, part of a data center corridor in Rockland County that includes other mapped facilities. New York state has 31 mapped data centers on record, but only one facility in the state publishes power figures, totaling 3 MW of disclosed capacity across the state. This facility's rank by published MW cannot be determined from available data.

Without published specifications, this campus cannot be evaluated against the thesis that compute density and power availability determine AI capability deployment. The absence of disclosed figures does not indicate the facility's actual capacity or purpose, only that Bloomberg has not published technical details for independent review.
